source_notes.data_absent: No relevant mode-consistent schedule, fare record, or non-null accessibility feature value in the canonical snapshot. Unknown availability is not a claim of physical absence.
source_notes.data_exists_but_unverified: Legacy facility fixtures, unconfirmed interchange/hub candidates, or fare tables requiring unverified cross-ID identity mapping cannot be promoted.
source_notes.topology_incomplete: Mode-consistent Metro/Rail topology absent; some bus variants contain unusable links or lack supported timetable waypoint semantics. Existing partial bus topology stays provisional.
source_notes.realtime_required: No authorized live source is connected.
source_notes.external_source_required: Personal transactions/nontransport or external scope remains outside assistant operations.
